To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

3WNews can: (a) recognize people names, locations and time expressions in news video transcript and resolve their ambiguous references; (b) identify people and locations that are actually present in video footage and use them to index the video; (c) support browsing of news video based on event time; and (d) provide a user interface that enables the user to browse the video by who, where, when, and by event.

1) people and location names are the best indexes for browsing news video, 2) ambiguous references in news video are resolved by using the visual context of people and locations, and 3) news video browsing by the time of news events can be achieved by recognizing time expressions in video transcript.

(1) people and location names are the most effective features for video retrieval and browsing, (2) the ambiguity in references can be resolved with the help of visual information, and (3) time expressions are useful features for video retrieval but not for browsing.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a system for browsing news videos by the three most important aspects of news: people, places, and time.
the problem of how to effectively browse news video using its semantic content.
how the video browsing can be enhanced by the information about the people and locations appearing in the video.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
3WNews is a novel system that provides a new browsing paradigm for news video.

3WNews is a novel system that supports browsing of news footage by the people and locations appearing in the video as well as the event time, and is based on the state-of-the-art technology in speech recognition, video indexing, and event time extraction.
the 3WNews is the first video browser that allows users to browse news video by the three dimensions of people, locations, and event time.

we have developed an integrated system for news video indexing and browsing that supports a wide range of queries and enables efficient browsing of video content.
we have developed a novel system for video browsing by the people and locations appearing in the video as well as the events that occurred.
3WNews is a novel system to browse news video in a more natural and effective way.

the people, location, and time information in news video can be used for more effective browsing of news footage.
the 3WNews system can be used to browse news video in ways that are more intuitive, informative, and useful for users.
news video is more effectively browsed by people, locations, and events than by the conventional broadcast time.
